title: heliotropium zeylanicum
intro: Heliotropium zeylanicum, commonly known as Zeylanic heliotrope, is a plant species within the borage family (Boraginaceae) that is native to Sri Lanka and parts of India. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues such as coughs and bronchitis due to its expectorant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions also extend to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of Heliotropium zeylanicum include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
